rationale: Across all supplied artifacts (the assurance case, findings matrix, method crosswalk, video script/outline/treatment/visual inventory, and whitepaper draft/outline), C-AUTH-002 is consistently used within its stated scope. Every artifact preserves the FAA roadmap's framing as non-binding, direction-setting guidance distinguishing static (learned) AI from online (learning) AI, requiring design-time assurance and renewed safety-assurance treatment for updates, without presenting it as an established means of compliance or formal model certification.
limitations: Review is limited to the supplied artifacts and citations of C-AUTH-002; it does not evaluate subsequent regulatory policy releases past the 2024 FAA Roadmap Version I.
